artifact_delivered: DQN trading with hyperparameter search — found optimal trade penalty 0.5%
workstream_summary: C536: Validated bin/dqn_trading.py (pre-written, uncommitted). Ran hyperparameter sweep on trade penalty: 0.2% → 290 trades/30.2%, 0.5% → 163 trades/88.2%, 1.0% → 171 trades/7.9%. Optimal penalty 0.5% gives 88.2% return (beats B&H 78.0%) with 163 trades. Walk-forward 2/3 windows beat B&H (was 1/3 at 0.2%). Key insight: trade penalty is not just regularization — it teaches selectivity which improves returns. MA crossover (174.3%) still strongest signal.
